description: This file defines a repository layer for managing 'notes' in a SQLite database. It provides functions for CRUD operations including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes, along with internal utility functions for timestamping and row parsing.

methods.name: str _now_iso()
methods.description: Returns the current UTC time as an ISO8601 formatted string.

methods.name: Dict _parse_note_row(row: sqlite3.Row)
methods.description: Converts a SQLite row into a dictionary with datetime fields as ISO strings.

methods.name: List[Dict] list_notes()
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all notes ordered by last update time.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] get_note(note_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a single note by its ID.

methods.name: Dict create_note(title: str, content: str)
methods.description: Creates a new note with the specified title and content, returning the created record.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] update_note(note_id: int, title: str, content: str)
methods.description: Updates an existing note's title and content, returning the updated record.

methods.name: bool delete_note(note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID and returns whether the deletion was successful.

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^def update_note(note_id: int, title: str, content: str) -> Optional[Dict]:$/
